messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] apigw-prod-eu elevated 5xx (502/504) - 10m aggregate 11.9% - paging @sara oncall
sara: acknowledging, grabbing it now. creating #incident-5512346789 and notifying infra + cs. :rotating_light:
lee: oncall here. seeing 502s spike across eu-west ingress layer, metrics show connection resets to inference-backend across multiple nodes.
david: customer impact: spikes affect web UI uploads and webhook delivery; estimated affected requests ~12% EU traffic. US unaffected.
sara: quick triage notes: logs show repeated "upstream reset" and "client prematurely closed" from nginx upstream. suspect connection churn / pool exhaustion.
lee: running quick health probes on ingress pods ->
```
# check socket states on ingress-0/1/2
kubectl exec -c proxy ingress-0 -- ss -tan | grep ESTAB | wc -l
kubectl logs ingress-0 -c proxy | tail -n 200 | grep -E "upstream prematurely closed|reset"
```
lee: observed high established connections and growing TIME_WAIT on 3 pods, reuse counters low. keepalive reuse seems failing.
sara: mitigation plan (short window):
- canary change: lower keepalive_timeout on ingress to 25s and reduce keepalive_requests to 50
- enable stricter upstream circuit-break for inference pool (fail fast)
- scale inference pool + autoscale override (+4 pods)
- shift 12% of EU traffic to eu-standby region for high-risk routes (/upload, /webhook)
lee: applying ingress canary now to two pods. will watch 2m window.
incident-bot: config-deploy started by lee: ingress/keepalive-canary -> success
sara: canary subset error rate dropped from 12% -> 5.5% within 3m. starting rollout to remaining ingresses.
lee: autoscaled inference-eu from 4 -> 8; pods becoming ready. backend 5xx rate trending down, p50 latency stable.
david: updating customers: status page draft ready, pinging CS to publish with estimated ETA for full recovery ~15m. @maria-cs can you push?
maria-cs: published status page and notified top customer contacts. added note about increased retries and possible webhook delays.
sara: after full rollout, EU 5xx rate at ~2.8% and steady for 10m. marking incident as mitigated but keeping channel open for 30m observation. :white_check_mark:
david: preliminary RCA notes: combination of keepalive defaults + bursty non-keepalive HTTP clients caused connection churn and exhausted upstream connection pools. follow-up: increase default upstream pool, add client guidance, and add circuit-break thresholds to runbook.
sara: creating postmortem and routing to eng-runtime + infra. will include measurable KPIs and thresholds for automated traffic shift next time.
incident-bot: incident state -> monitoring, pages silenced.
